title: Helios Raptor Red

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Airoh Helios Raptor Red is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1137g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~98 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Lightweight jet helmet with retractable sun visor and Bluetooth ready.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for an open-face fit with a secure chin bar; typically runs true to size with a semi-slim profile that accommodates most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to the fixed shell geometry. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Airoh Helios Raptor Red: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Airoh Helios Raptor Red: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Airoh Helios Raptor Red. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Airoh's Open Face lineup, the Helios Raptor Red brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Airoh Helios Raptor Red represents Airoh's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Airoh Helios Raptor Red delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
